options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: deviceId
options.description: DeviceId query parameter. The device UUID. Examples `deviceId=6bef213c-19ca-4170-8375-b694e251101c` (single deviceId is requested) `deviceId=6bef213c-19ca-4170-8375-b694e251101c&deviceId=32219612-819e-4b5e-a96b-cf22aca13dd9 (multiple networkDeviceIds with & separator).

options.name: deviceName
options.description: DeviceName query parameter. Name of the device. This parameter supports wildcard (`*`) character -based search. Example `wnbu-sjc*` or `*wnbu-sjc*` or `*wnbu-sjc` Examples deviceName=wnbu-sjc24.cisco.com (single device name is requested) deviceName=wnbu-sjc24.cisco.com&deviceName=wnbu-sjc22.cisco.com (multiple device names are requested).

options.name: deviceSiteHierarchyId
options.description: DeviceSiteHierarchyId query parameter. The full hierarchy breakdown of the site tree in id form starting from Global site UUID and ending with the specific site UUID. (Ex. `globalUuid/areaUuid/buildingUuid/floorUuid`) This field supports wildcard asterisk (`*`) character search support. E.g. `*uuid*, *uuid, uuid*` Examples `?deviceSiteHierarchyId=globalUuid/areaUuid/buildingUuid/floorUuid `(single siteHierarchyId requested) ` ?deviceSiteHierarchyId=globalUuid/areaUuid/buildingUuid/floorUuid&devi

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. End time to which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Unique id of the AAA Service. It is the combination of AAA Server IP (`serverIp`) and Device UUID (`deviceId`) separated by underscore (`_`). Example If `serverIp` is `10.76.81.33` and `deviceId` is `6bef213c-19ca-4170-8375-b694e251101c`, then the `id` would be `10.76.81.33_6bef213c-19ca-4170-8375-b694e251101c`.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Maximum number of records to return.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Specifies the starting point within all records returned by the API. It's one based offset. The starting value is 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. The sort order of the field ascending or descending.

options.name: serverIp
options.description: ServerIp query parameter. IP Address of the AAA Server. This parameter supports wildcard (`*`) character -based search. Example `10.76.81.*` or `*56.78*` or `*50.28` Examples serverIp=10.42.3.31 (single IP Address is requested) serverIp=10.42.3.31&serverIp=name2&fabricVnName=name3 (multiple IP Addresses are requested).

options.name: siteHierarchy
options.description: SiteHierarchy query parameter. The full hierarchical breakdown of the site tree starting from Global site name and ending with the specific site name. The Root site is named "Global" (Ex. `Global/AreaName/BuildingName/FloorName`) This field supports wildcard asterisk (`*`) character search support. E.g. `*/San*, */San, /San*` Examples `?siteHierarchy=Global/AreaName/BuildingName/FloorName` (single siteHierarchy requested) `?siteHierarchy=Global/AreaName/BuildingName/FloorName&siteHierarchy=Gl ob

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. The UUID of the site. (Ex. `flooruuid`) Examples `?siteId=id1` (single id requested) `?siteId=id1&siteId=id2&siteId=id3` (multiple ids requested).

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. Field name on which sorting needs to be done.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Start time from which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive. If `startTime` is not provided, API will default to current time.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
